Distance ladder — 50 m steps up to 250 m then 100 m steps. The app floors to the nearest step so 350 m says 300. No 350/450 clips by design — don't re-add them.

Navigation twin of the alert ladder: same words, comma instead of the full stop, because here the distance OPENS the sentence ('in 200 meters, turn right') and the sentence-final intonation sounded wrong (founder, 2026-09-09).

Navigation voice prompts (mobile feat/nav-voice-guidance). Spoken by NavigationVoiceGuide after a distance-ladder clip ('in 200 meters.' + 'turn right.') or alone as the at-the-turn prompt — keep every cell a complete short sentence.

Slight left, left fork, left merge, left on-ramp AND left off-ramp — Mapbox sometimes reports an exit maneuver for staying on the same motorway, so the vaguer 'keep' is the safe wording (founder, 2026-09-08).
Slight right, right fork, right merge, right on-ramp AND right off-ramp — see nav_keep_left.
